purpose: Exclusion audit only. These identities are not catalogue records and are not exported to README, CSV or BibTeX.

excluded_records.title: Ditto: Fair and Robust Federated Learning Through Personalization
excluded_records.reason: Personalized-objective regularization and client-level fairness/robustness are the core contributions; no model-fusion-specific mechanism is established.
excluded_records.locator: PDF pp.1–3: definitions of fairness/robustness; Section 3 objective

excluded_records.title: Agnostic Federated Learning
excluded_records.reason: Optimizes a centralized training objective against mixtures of client distributions; this is a general federated objective/optimization method, not model fusion.
excluded_records.locator: PDF pp.1,3: motivation and agnostic loss

excluded_records.title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
excluded_records.reason: Generic iterative local optimization and coordinate averaging is a training baseline, not a model-fusion-specific contribution under the corrected inclusion rule. Any necessary relation can be explained through a retained fusion paper rather than retaining an independent catalogue record.
excluded_records.locator: PDF pp.1–3: problem setup and iterative averaging

excluded_records.title: Machine Learning with Adversaries: Byzantine Tolerant Gradient Descent
excluded_records.reason: Selects a gradient under Byzantine distributed-optimization assumptions; the protected object and mechanism are generic gradient aggregation rather than model fusion.
excluded_records.locator: PDF pp.1,3: abstract and system model

excluded_records.title: The Limitations of Federated Learning in Sybil Settings
excluded_records.reason: Detects/downweights coordinated client updates from similarity histories; a generic Sybil defense without a model-fusion-specific contribution.
excluded_records.locator: PDF pp.1–2: mechanism and threat model

excluded_records.title: FLTrust: Byzantine-robust Federated Learning via Trust Bootstrapping
excluded_records.reason: Uses trusted root data to score and normalize client updates for general Byzantine-robust training; not a model-fusion-specific method.
excluded_records.locator: Official publication metadata and abstract

excluded_records.title: RoFL: Robustness of Secure Federated Learning
excluded_records.reason: Adds privacy-preserving proofs of update norm bounds to secure aggregation; a generic federated protocol defense, not a fusion-specific operator or constraint.
excluded_records.locator: Sections I–III

excluded_records.title: Practical Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning
excluded_records.reason: A cryptographic aggregate-computation protocol protecting individual contributions; it does not itself study model fusion.
excluded_records.locator: Abstract

excluded_records.title: FedXDS: Leveraging Model Attribution Methods to counteract Data Heterogeneity in Federated Learning
excluded_records.reason: Attribution controls transformed-example sharing before ordinary FedAvg; the main contribution concerns data sharing and heterogeneity, not explaining or constructing model fusion.
excluded_records.locator: PDF pp.3–5 §4 and Algorithms 1–2: attribution-derived data sharing, aggregation and metric-privacy discussion

excluded_records.title: ShapleyFL: Robust Federated Learning Based on Shapley Value
excluded_records.reason: Sequential client-contribution estimation, adaptive update weighting and importance sampling improve generic federated training; a weighted update sum alone is insufficient for inclusion as model fusion.
excluded_records.locator: PDF p.4 §4.1: validation utility, partial and surrogate federated Shapley values

excluded_records.title: Breaking Privacy in Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning
excluded_records.reason: The attacks target partial-training cohort leakage and secure-aggregation protocol behavior. No specific independently trained-model fusion operator is the attack object; the prior link to fusion was too indirect.
excluded_records.locator: Author-hosted final RAID PDF pp.4–6, §§4–5; system/threat model and two attacks

excluded_records.title: Tackling the Objective Inconsistency Problem in Heterogeneous Federated Optimization
excluded_records.reason: Its contribution corrects local-solver objective inconsistency by normalizing accumulated optimization updates; it does not introduce model alignment, expert composition, distillation, or a model-reuse fusion objective.
excluded_records.locator: Final NeurIPS PDF pp.5–6, Sections 4.1–4.2: normalized update framework and objective inconsistency; p.8, Section 5 and Theorem 3: FedNova and assumptions

excluded_records.title: Buffalo: Biomedical Vision-Language Understanding with Cross-Modal Prototype and Federated Foundation Model Collaboration
excluded_records.reason: The accessible publisher abstract establishes prototype imputation and federated fine-tuning, but does not establish a direct multi-model fusion operator. Move out of included records pending mechanism-level evidence rather than asserting that the paper is definitively unrelated.
excluded_records.locator: Official ACM SIGWEB proceedings: Buffalo entry and abstract, within SESSION: Full Research Papers; the subsequent Short Research Papers heading begins after this entry.

excluded_records.title: FedBone: Towards Large-Scale Federated Multi-Task Learning
excluded_records.reason: The inspected mechanism aggregates task gradients for a shared backbone in split training. Combining optimization gradients is not sufficient for model-fusion inclusion under the corrected scope.
excluded_records.locator: Final JCST PDF p.1 (printed1040): complete author list, final issue, Regular Paper.; Final JCST PDF pp.5–6 (printed1044–1045), Sections3.2–3.3, Figure2 and Algorithm1: server backbone, local modules, forward/backward split and shared gradient update.; Final JCST PDF pp.6–7 (printed1045–1046), Section3.4: historical-gradient attention and projection of conflicting task gradients.; Final JCST PDF p.7 (printed1046), Section3.5: task adaptation module.

excluded_records.title: FairFHTL: Achieving Task-Agnostic Fairness in Federated Hetero-Task Learning
excluded_records.reason: Metadata and a coauthor synopsis establish task-fairness optimization over shared representations/updates, but not a direct model-fusion object or operator. Keep only as an uncounted screening lead if retained at all.
excluded_records.locator: Coauthor entry FairFHTL, 2025: complete title/authors and short author-written description of task fairness, shared representations and allocation across updates. This is not treated as the paper abstract.

excluded_records.title: HeteroFL: Computation and Communication Efficient Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Clients
excluded_records.reason: Its principal contribution allocates and trains nested subnetworks of one shared model. Known-coordinate averaging is infrastructure for resource-heterogeneous training, not a distinct model-fusion study under the corrected scope.
excluded_records.locator: Author arXiv v3 PDF pp.3–5, Sections 3.1–3.3, Equations 1–4 and Algorithm 1: nested coordinates, aggregation, static BN and scaling; p.7, Section 4: masked class outputs and selective last-layer aggregation

excluded_records.title: FedRolex: Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning with Rolling Sub-Model Extraction
excluded_records.reason: The primary novelty is rolling submodel extraction and coverage of a shared supernetwork. Selective coordinate averaging does not on its own turn this resource-scheduling method into model-fusion research.
excluded_records.locator: Final NeurIPS PDF pp.3–5, Sections 2–3.3 and Algorithm 1: static/random extraction comparison, rolling window and selective per-coordinate averaging

excluded_records.title: Federated Multi-Task Learning
excluded_records.reason: Federated multi-task optimization; this review did not establish a direct source-model fusion contribution.
excluded_records.locator: Official abstract; not a full-method exclusion audit

excluded_records.title: An Efficient Framework for Clustered Federated Learning
excluded_records.reason: Cluster assignment and within-cluster training are not sufficient evidence for model-fusion inclusion.
excluded_records.locator: Official abstract; not a full-method exclusion audit

excluded_records.title: FedProto: Federated Prototype Learning across Heterogeneous Clients
excluded_records.reason: Class-prototype sharing and prototype-regularized/predictive local models fall outside the current source-model/module fusion boundary.
excluded_records.locator: Methodology Eqs. 3–5, Discussion / Model Inference

excluded_records.title: FedTGP: Trainable Global Prototypes with Adaptive-Margin-Enhanced Contrastive Learning for Data and Model Heterogeneity in Federated Learning
excluded_records.reason: Trainable global class prototypes improve separability; no direct source-model/module fusion mechanism is established under the same rule as FedProto.
excluded_records.locator: Method / FedTGP Framework; Eq. 11

excluded_records.title: Parasite: planting durable backdoors against continual federated model fusion via discriminative feature pushing-pulling
excluded_records.reason: Publisher preview shows persistent local backdoor training under ordinary FL aggregation; an independent fusion-specific operator or attack interface was not established. This is a provisional scope decision, not proof of irrelevance.
excluded_records.locator: Publisher preview: abstract, introduction and experimental setting; full text not assessed
